sections.title: Practice 1: Although / Despite / In spite of
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: Despite his old age, he runs every morning. → Although he is old, he runs every morning.

questions.original: Although we tried very hard, we failed.
answers: of trying very hard, we failed.
of our trying very hard, we failed.
of the fact that we tried very hard, we failed.
of our great effort, we failed.
questions.explanation: Although + mệnh đề → In spite of + V-ing / danh từ / the fact that + mệnh đề. Cùng chủ ngữ “we” nên dùng “trying very hard”.

questions.original: Although he was very tired, he kept on working.
answers: being very tired, he kept on working.
his being very tired, he kept on working.
his great tiredness, he kept on working.
the fact that he was very tired, he kept on working.
questions.explanation: Although + mệnh đề → Despite + V-ing / danh từ / the fact that + mệnh đề. “was very tired” → “being very tired” (hoặc danh từ “tiredness”).

questions.original: Despite having several broken bones, John was able to compete in the race.
questions.prefix: John was able to compete in the race even
answers: though he had
though he'd had
questions.explanation: Despite + V-ing → even though + mệnh đề. “having several broken bones” → “he had several broken bones” (thì quá khứ như câu gốc).

questions.original: Although it rained heavily, my father went to work.
answers: heavy rain, my father went to work.
heavy rainfall, my father went to work.
fact that it rained heavily, my father went to work.
questions.explanation: Although + mệnh đề → Despite + danh từ. “it rained heavily” → “the heavy rain” (trạng từ → tính từ, động từ → danh từ).

questions.original: In spite of admiring Shakespeare's comedies, I cannot agree that they are any superior to his tragedies.
questions.suffix: , I cannot agree that they are any superior to his tragedies.
answers: admire Shakespeare's comedies
do admire Shakespeare's comedies
admire the comedies of Shakespeare
questions.explanation: In spite of + V-ing → Although + mệnh đề. “admiring” → “I admire” (chủ ngữ “I” đã có sẵn ở phần cho trước).

sections.title: Practice 2: It + be + adj + to V / V-ing + be + adj
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: He thinks speaking English is difficult. → He thinks it is difficult to speak English.

questions.original: It's important to be there on time.
answers: there on time is important.
there on time is very important.
questions.explanation: It + be + adj + to V → To V + be + adj. Đưa động từ nguyên mẫu lên làm chủ ngữ.

questions.original: It's difficult to understand what she's talking about.
answers: what she's talking about is difficult.
what she is talking about is difficult.
questions.explanation: It + be + adj + to V → To V + be + adj. Mệnh đề “what she’s talking about” đi theo động từ “understand”.

questions.original: It is very relaxing to spend a day in the country.
answers: a day in the country is very relaxing.
a day in the country is relaxing.
questions.explanation: It + be + adj + to V → To V + be + adj. Cụm “to spend a day in the country” làm chủ ngữ.

questions.original: It must be hard to live on your salary.
answers: on your salary must be hard.
on your salary must be difficult.
questions.explanation: It + be + adj + to V → V-ing + be + adj. Danh động từ “living” làm chủ ngữ, giữ “must be”.

questions.original: Sitting here with you is so nice.
answers: is so nice to sit here with you.
is so nice to be sitting here with you.
is very nice to sit here with you.
questions.explanation: V-ing + be + adj → It + be + adj + to V. Dùng “it” làm chủ ngữ giả, đưa “to sit…” ra sau tính từ.

sections.title: Practice 3: Adj + enough to / So… that / Such… that
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: It was such a cold day that we stayed indoors. → The day was so cold that we stayed indoors.

questions.original: He is rich enough to buy whatever he wants
answers: rich that he can buy whatever he wants.
rich that he can buy anything he wants.
rich he can buy whatever he wants.
questions.explanation: adj + enough to V → so + adj + that + mệnh đề. “enough to buy” → “that he can buy”.

questions.original: Richard was so tall he could change light bulbs in some rooms without having to stand on a chair.
questions.suffix: without having to stand on a chair.
answers: tall enough to change light bulbs in some rooms
questions.explanation: so + adj + that + mệnh đề → adj + enough to V. Bỏ “so” và “he could”, thêm “enough to change”.

questions.original: It was such a boring film that we left before the end.
answers: boring that we left before the end.
boring we left before the end.
questions.explanation: such + a + adj + noun + that → noun + be + so + adj + that. “such a boring film” → “The film was so boring”.

questions.original: The question was so difficult that no one could answer it.
answers: a difficult question that no one could answer it.
a difficult question that nobody could answer it.
a difficult question no one could answer.
questions.explanation: so + adj + that → such + a/an + adj + noun + that. “The question was so difficult” → “It was such a difficult question”.

questions.original: She isn't very intelligent so she can't do that exercise.
answers: enough to do that exercise.
enough to be able to do that exercise.
questions.explanation: (not) adj + so + can’t V → not + adj + enough to V. “isn’t very intelligent so she can’t…” → “isn’t intelligent enough to do…”.

sections.title: Practice 4: Comparison
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: Mai is the most beautiful girl in her school. → Nobody is as beautiful as Mai in her school.

questions.original: My brother is shorter than all the other boys in his class.
answers: shortest boy
shortest one
shortest
questions.explanation: So sánh hơn với “all the other” → so sánh nhất: shorter than all the other boys = the shortest boy in the class.

questions.original: They don't speak English as fluently as we do.
answers: English more fluently than they do.
English more fluently than them.
English more fluently than they speak it.
questions.explanation: not as + adv + as → so sánh hơn với chủ ngữ đảo lại: “They don’t speak… as fluently as we” = “We speak… more fluently than they do”.

questions.original: He doesn't run as fast as his brother.
answers: runs faster than he does.
runs faster than him.
runs faster than he runs.
questions.explanation: not as + adv + as → so sánh hơn với chủ ngữ đảo lại: “He doesn’t run as fast as his brother” = “His brother runs faster than he does”.

questions.original: The film I saw last week was better than this one.
answers: worse than the film I saw last week.
worse than the one I saw last week.
worse than the film that I saw last week.
worse than the one that I saw last week.
questions.explanation: Đảo hai vế so sánh và dùng tính từ trái nghĩa: better than this one → this film is worse than the film I saw last week.

questions.original: The ring I bought was more expensive than the others in the shop.
answers: the most expensive
questions.explanation: So sánh hơn với “the others” → so sánh nhất: more expensive than the others = the most expensive.

sections.title: Practice 5: Ago / Since / For
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: Naomi began studying Korean 5 years ago. → Naomi has been studying (has studied) Korean for 5 years.
The last time I played football was in 2010. → I haven't played football since 2010.

questions.original: She last saw him when she was ten.
answers: seen him since she was ten.
seen him since she was 10.
questions.explanation: The last time + quá khứ → hasn’t/haven’t + V3 + since + mốc thời gian. Mốc “when she was ten” → “since she was ten”.

questions.original: Tom began to study English a year ago.
answers: studied English for a year.
been studying English for a year.
studied English for one year.
been studying English for one year.
questions.explanation: S + began + V-ing/to V + khoảng thời gian + ago → S + has/have + V3 (been V-ing) + for + khoảng thời gian.

questions.original: They haven't written email for two months.
answers: wrote an email two months ago.
wrote an e-mail two months ago.
wrote email two months ago.
wrote emails two months ago.
questions.explanation: haven’t V3 + for + khoảng thời gian → S + last + V2 + khoảng thời gian + ago.

questions.original: The last time we were here was in 1980.
answers: been here since 1980.
questions.explanation: The last time + was in + năm → haven’t + V3 + since + năm. “were here” → “been here”.

questions.original: The last time Jack went swimming was in 2012.
answers: been swimming since 2012.
gone swimming since 2012.
swum since 2012.
questions.explanation: The last time + quá khứ đơn → hasn’t + V3 + since + mốc thời gian. “went swimming” → “gone/been swimming”.

sections.title: Practice 6: Should / Ought to — Had better
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: 'I have an interview tomorrow, so I ought to leave soon,' Michael said. → 'I have an interview tomorrow, so I had better leave soon,' Michael said.

questions.original: If you're not well, you ought to ask Ann to go instead.
answers: better ask Ann to go instead if you're not well.
better ask Ann to go instead if you are not well.
better ask Ann to go instead if you aren't well.
questions.explanation: ought to / should + V → had better + V (viết tắt “’d better”). Mệnh đề “If…” đưa xuống cuối câu vì phần cho sẵn bắt đầu bằng “You’d”.

questions.original: It's cold outside, so you should wear a warm coat.
answers: outside, so you'd better wear a warm coat.
outside so you'd better wear a warm coat.
outside, so you had better wear a warm coat.
questions.explanation: should + V → had better + V. Phần cho sẵn gồm “It’s cold” và “you’d”; học viên điền “outside, so” ở giữa và “better wear a warm coat” ở cuối.

questions.original: As you are feeling ill, you shouldn't go to work.
answers: are feeling ill, you'd better not go to work.
are feeling ill, you had better not go to work.
feel ill, you'd better not go to work.
questions.explanation: shouldn’t + V → had better not + V. Phủ định của “had better” là “had better not” (không phải “hadn’t better”).

questions.original: Kids, you should leave now, or you will miss the school bus.
answers: better leave now, or you will miss the school bus.
better leave now, or you'll miss the school bus.
better leave now or you will miss the school bus.
better leave now or you'll miss the school bus.
questions.explanation: should + V → had better + V (’d better + V). Phần còn lại của câu giữ nguyên.

questions.original: You will need a high school education for any good job, so you shouldn't quit high school.
answers: will need a high school education for any good job, you'd better not quit high school.
will need a high school education for any good job, you had better not quit high school.
need a high school education for any good job, you'd better not quit high school.
questions.explanation: “so” (kết quả) → “Since” (nguyên nhân) ở đầu câu; shouldn’t + V → had better not + V.

sections.title: Practice 7: If I were you — You’d better — Advise you to V
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: If I were you, I would go and speak to your boss. → I advise you to go and speak to your boss.

questions.original: I advise you to go now or you'll be late.
answers: better go now or you'll be late.
better go now or you will be late.
better go now, or you'll be late.
better go now, or you will be late.
questions.explanation: advise you to V → You’d better V. Mệnh đề “or you’ll be late” giữ nguyên.

questions.original: I advise you not to go to work today
answers: better not go to work today.
questions.explanation: advise you not to V → You’d better not V (phủ định của “had better” là “had better not”).

questions.original: You had better begin by introducing yourself.
answers: you to begin by introducing yourself.
questions.explanation: You had better V → I advise you to V. Sau “advise somebody” là to-infinitive.

questions.original: If I were you, I would forget about buying a new house.
answers: you to forget about buying a new house.
questions.explanation: If I were you, I would V → I advise you to V. Lời khuyên dạng câu điều kiện chuyển sang “advise you to V”.

questions.original: You'd better take a complete rest
answers: you to take a complete rest.
you to have a complete rest.
questions.explanation: You’d better V → I advise you to V. Sau “advise somebody” là to-infinitive.

sections.title: Practice 8: So… that / Such… that / Enough / Too… to
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: This song is simple enough for all of us to sing. → This song is so simple that all of us can sing it.
This song is simple enough for all of us to sing. → It is such a simple song that all of us can sing it.
It was such hot tea that I couldn't drink it. → The tea was so hot that I couldn't drink it.
It was such hot tea that I couldn't drink it. → The tea was too hot for me to drink.

questions.original: The water was so cold that the children could not swim in it.
answers: cold for the children to swim in.
questions.explanation: so + adj + that + S + can’t V → too + adj + (for sb) + to V. Bỏ đại từ “it” ở cuối vì “water” đã là tân ngữ của “in”.

questions.original: They didn't arrive early enough to see the 1st half of the match.
answers: late to see the 1st half of the match.
late to see the first half of the match.
questions.explanation: not + adj + enough to V → too + adj trái nghĩa + to V. “not early enough” = “too late”.

questions.original: He was so tired that he couldn't stay awake until the end of the film.
answers: tired to stay awake until the end of the film.
questions.explanation: so + adj + that + S + can’t V → too + adj + to V. Cùng chủ ngữ “he” nên không cần “for sb”.

questions.original: The runner was so exhausted that he couldn't complete the last lap of the race.
answers: exhausted to complete the last lap of the race.
questions.explanation: so + adj + that + S + can’t V → too + adj + to V. Cùng chủ ngữ nên bỏ “for sb”.

questions.original: Peter is too young to see the horror film.
answers: old enough to see the horror film.
questions.explanation: too + adj + to V → not + adj trái nghĩa + enough to V. “too young” = “not old enough”.

questions.original: The problem is too difficult for her to solve.
answers: a difficult problem that she can't solve it.
a difficult problem that she cannot solve it.
a difficult problem that she couldn't solve it.
questions.explanation: too + adj + (for sb) to V → such + a/an + adj + noun + that + S + can’t V. Thêm đại từ “it” làm tân ngữ trong mệnh đề that.

questions.original: He speaks too fast to be understood.
answers: fast that he can't be understood.
fast that nobody can understand him.
fast that no one can understand him.
fast that he cannot be understood.
questions.explanation: too + adv + to V → so + adv + that + mệnh đề phủ định. Giữ bị động hoặc đổi sang chủ động với “nobody”.

questions.original: The house isn't big enough for us to live in.
answers: small for us to live in.
questions.explanation: not + adj + enough (for sb) to V → too + adj trái nghĩa + (for sb) to V. “not big enough” = “too small”.

questions.original: The meat was so rotten that it had to be thrown away.
answers: such rotten meat that it had to be thrown away.
questions.explanation: so + adj + that → such + adj + noun (không đếm được, không có a/an) + that. “The meat was so rotten” → “It was such rotten meat”.

questions.original: She is such a good tennis player that she wins all her matches.
answers: well that she wins all her matches.
well that she wins every match.
questions.explanation: such + a + adj + noun + that → V + so + adv + that. “a good tennis player” → “plays tennis so well”.

sections.title: Practice 9: If-clauses
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: She isn't tall; that's why she can't reach that shelf. → If she were taller, she could reach that shelf.
I have to get home before nine. Otherwise my father will be angry with me. → My father will be angry with me if I don't get home before nine.
I didn't understand what he was saying because I hadn't read his book. → If I had read his book I would have understood what he was saying.

questions.original: My brother didn't buy that car because he didn't have enough money.
answers: had had enough money, he would have bought that car.
had had enough money, he'd have bought that car.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện loại 3 (trái với quá khứ): If + had V3, S + would have V3. “didn’t have” → “had had”, “didn’t buy” → “would have bought”.

questions.original: People don't understand him because he doesn't speak clearly.
answers: clearly, people would understand him.
clearly, people would understand what he says.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện loại 2 (trái với hiện tại): If + V2, S + would V. Khẳng định ↔ phủ định so với câu gốc.

questions.original: He smokes too much; perhaps that's why he can't get rid of his cough.
answers: didn't smoke so much, he could get rid of his cough.
didn't smoke so much, he might get rid of his cough.
didn't smoke so much, he would be able to get rid of his cough.
didn't smoke too much, he could get rid of his cough.
didn't smoke too much, he might get rid of his cough.
smoked less, he could get rid of his cough.
smoked less, he might get rid of his cough.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện loại 2: If + V2 (phủ định), S + could/might/would V. “perhaps” gợi ý dùng “might/could”.

questions.original: I live near my office, so I don't spend much time travelling to work.
answers: didn't live near my office, I would spend a lot of time travelling to work.
didn't live near my office, I would spend much time travelling to work.
did not live near my office, I would spend a lot of time travelling to work.
didn't live near my office, I'd spend a lot of time travelling to work.
lived far from my office, I would spend a lot of time travelling to work.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện loại 2: If + V2, S + would V. Đổi khẳng định ↔ phủ định: “live near” → “didn’t live near”, “don’t spend much” → “would spend a lot of”.

questions.original: You didn't tell me we had run out of bread, so I didn't buy any.
answers: told me we had run out of bread, I would have bought some.
told me we had run out of bread, I'd have bought some.
told me we had run out of bread, I would have bought any.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện loại 3: If + had V3, S + would have V3. Phủ định → khẳng định: “any” → “some”.

sections.title: Practice 10: If — Unless
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: Unless he phones her immediately, he won't get any information. → If he doesn't phone her immediately, he won't get any information.

questions.original: If you don't go on a diet you won't lose weight.
answers: on a diet, you won't lose weight.
on a diet you won't lose weight.
on a diet, you will not lose weight.
questions.explanation: If… not → Unless + mệnh đề khẳng định. “don’t go” → “go”; “unless” đã mang nghĩa phủ định nên không dùng “not”.

questions.original: If there isn't anything in the fridge, I'll go to the shops.
answers: something in the fridge, I'll go to the shops.
something in the fridge, I will go to the shops.
anything in the fridge, I'll go to the shops.
questions.explanation: If… not → Unless + mệnh đề khẳng định. “isn’t anything” → “is something”.

questions.original: If you keep adding salt, you'll spoil the dinner.
answers: adding salt, you'll spoil the dinner.
adding salt, you will spoil the dinner.
adding salt you'll spoil the dinner.
questions.explanation: If + keep V-ing (tiếp tục) = Unless + stop V-ing. “keep adding” ≈ “don’t stop adding”, nên dùng “Unless you stop adding…”.

questions.original: Unless it rains soon, a lot of our crops will be lost.
questions.suffix: , a lot of our crops will be lost.
answers: doesn't rain soon
does not rain soon
questions.explanation: Unless + khẳng định → If… not. “Unless it rains” → “If it doesn’t rain”.

questions.original: If you don't leave immediately, I will call a policeman.
answers: you leave immediately, I will call a policeman.
you leave immediately, I'll call a policeman.
you leave immediately I will call a policeman.
questions.explanation: If… not → Unless + mệnh đề khẳng định. “don’t leave” → “leave”.

sections.title: Practice 11: Wish + noun clauses
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: Diana didn't apply for the job in the library and regrets it now. → Diana wishes she had applied for the job in the library.

questions.original: I'm sorry we can't find a taxi.
answers: we could find a taxi.
we were able to find a taxi.
questions.explanation: Điều ước ở hiện tại: wish + S + V2/could V. “can’t find” → “could find”.

questions.original: I didn't know that she was ill.
answers: I had known that she was ill.
I had known she was ill.
I'd known that she was ill.
I'd known she was ill.
questions.explanation: Điều ước trái với quá khứ: wish + S + had V3. “didn’t know” → “had known”.

questions.original: He is sorry that he hasn't done his homework.
answers: had done his homework.
had done his homework already.
questions.explanation: Tiếc nuối về việc chưa làm: wish + S + had V3. “hasn’t done” → “had done”.

questions.original: It rained a lot when we were in England.
answers: it hadn't rained so much when we were in England.
it hadn't rained a lot when we were in England.
it hadn't rained so much while we were in England.
it had not rained so much when we were in England.
questions.explanation: Điều ước trái với quá khứ: wish + S + had V3; khẳng định → phủ định: “rained a lot” → “hadn’t rained so much”.

questions.original: What a pity I don't know the answer to this question.
answers: I knew the answer to this question.
questions.explanation: Điều ước ở hiện tại: wish + S + V2. “don’t know” → “knew”.

sections.title: Practice 12: Active — Passive
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: Someone carried my luggage to the train station. → My luggage was carried to the train station.

questions.original: We clean the garage every day.
answers: is cleaned every day.
is cleaned by us every day.
questions.explanation: Bị động thì hiện tại đơn: S + am/is/are + V3. “We clean the garage” → “The garage is cleaned”.

questions.original: The police arrested two hundred people.
answers: were arrested by the police.
were arrested.
questions.explanation: Bị động thì quá khứ đơn: S + was/were + V3 (+ by agent). Chủ ngữ số nhiều nên dùng “were”.

questions.original: They have cancelled the meeting.
answers: has been cancelled.
has been canceled.
has been cancelled by them.
questions.explanation: Bị động thì hiện tại hoàn thành: S + has/have been + V3. “They” chung chung nên có thể bỏ.

questions.original: The secretary has just finished the report.
answers: has just been finished by the secretary.
has just been finished.
questions.explanation: Bị động thì hiện tại hoàn thành: S + has been + V3; trạng từ “just” đứng giữa “has” và “been”.

questions.original: The journalists were given an interesting interview by the Prime Minister.
answers: gave the journalists an interesting interview.
gave an interesting interview to the journalists.
questions.explanation: Bị động → chủ động: chuyển “by the Prime Minister” lên làm chủ ngữ, “were given” → “gave” (quá khứ đơn).

sections.title: Practice 13: Causative
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: She has the hairdresser do her hair every month. → She has her hair done every month.

questions.original: We ask someone to check the accounts every month.
answers: accounts checked every month.
questions.explanation: Bị động nhờ vả: have + tân ngữ + V3. “ask someone to check the accounts” → “have the accounts checked”.

questions.original: I had someone dry-clean my coat a week ago.
answers: my coat dry-cleaned a week ago.
my coat dry cleaned a week ago.
questions.explanation: Causative bị động: had + tân ngữ + V3. “someone dry-clean my coat” → “my coat dry-cleaned”.

questions.original: An engineer repaired my computer a week ago.
answers: engineer to repair my computer a week ago.
engineer to fix my computer a week ago.
questions.explanation: Causative chủ động: get + người + to V + vật. “An engineer repaired” → “I got an engineer to repair”.

questions.original: I'm going to have the barber cut my hair tomorrow.
answers: have my hair cut tomorrow.
get my hair cut tomorrow.
questions.explanation: have + người + V → have + vật + V3 (bỏ người thực hiện): “have the barber cut my hair” → “have my hair cut”.

questions.original: We'll probably have someone paint our house next month.
answers: house painted next month.
questions.explanation: have someone V → get/have + vật + V3. “paint our house” → “get our house painted”.

sections.title: Practice 14: Because / As / Since — Because of / Due to
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: Because she behaves well, everybody loves her. → Because of her good behavior, everybody loves her.

questions.original: As he has behaved badly, he must be punished.
answers: bad behavior, he must be punished.
bad behaviour, he must be punished.
bad behaviour he must be punished.
having behaved badly, he must be punished.
questions.explanation: As + mệnh đề → Due to + danh từ. “behaved badly” → “bad behavior” (trạng từ → tính từ, động từ → danh từ).

questions.original: Because the weather is hot, we are going swimming.
answers: the hot weather, we are going swimming.
the hot weather we are going swimming.
the weather being hot, we are going swimming.
questions.explanation: Because + mệnh đề → Because of + danh từ. “the weather is hot” → “the hot weather”.

questions.original: I can't do the work because I'm ill.
answers: my illness, I can't do the work.
being ill, I can't do the work.
my being ill, I can't do the work.
my illness I can't do the work.
questions.explanation: Because + mệnh đề → Because of + danh từ/V-ing; đảo mệnh đề lên đầu. “I’m ill” → “my illness” / “being ill”.

questions.original: The car crashed because the driver was careless.
answers: driver's carelessness, the car crashed.
driver's carelessness the car crashed.
carelessness of the driver, the car crashed.
driver being careless, the car crashed.
driver's being careless, the car crashed.
questions.explanation: Because + mệnh đề → Because of + danh từ. “the driver was careless” → “the driver’s carelessness” (tính từ → danh từ).

questions.original: Because of her poor performance, she was eliminated.
answers: she performed poorly.
she performed badly.
her performance was poor.
she didn't perform well.
she did not perform well.
questions.explanation: Because of + danh từ → Because + mệnh đề. “her poor performance” → “she performed poorly”.

questions.original: He had to drop out at sixteen because of his father's sudden death.
answers: died suddenly, he had to drop out at sixteen.
died unexpectedly, he had to drop out at sixteen.
suddenly died, he had to drop out at sixteen.
died suddenly he had to drop out at sixteen.
questions.explanation: Because of + danh từ → Because + mệnh đề. “his father’s sudden death” → “his father died suddenly”.

sections.title: Practice 15: It takes (sb) + time + to V
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: I spent three weeks reading War and Peace. → It took me three weeks to read War and Peace.
It took her a long time to decide what to eat. → She spent a long time deciding what to eat.

questions.original: I walked to school in 15 minutes.
answers: me 15 minutes to walk to school.
me fifteen minutes to walk to school.
me 15 minutes to get to school.
questions.explanation: S + V + in + thời gian → It takes/took + sb + thời gian + to V. Dùng “took” vì câu gốc ở quá khứ.

questions.original: The flight to Hanoi lasts an hour and a half.
answers: an hour and a half to fly to Hanoi.
an hour and a half to get to Hanoi by plane.
an hour and a half to fly there.
an hour and a half to get to Hanoi by air.
questions.explanation: lasts + thời gian → It takes + thời gian + to V. “The flight to Hanoi” → “to fly to Hanoi”.

questions.original: It took them 5 months to build the house.
answers: spent 5 months building the house.
spent five months building the house.
spent 5 months on building the house.
questions.explanation: It took sb + thời gian + to V → S + spent + thời gian + V-ing.

questions.original: I can get to school in 20 minutes.
answers: me 20 minutes to get to school.
me twenty minutes to get to school.
me 20 minutes to go to school.
questions.explanation: S + V + in + thời gian → It takes + sb + thời gian + to V. Giữ thì hiện tại “takes”.

questions.original: When Mary wanted a new car, she had to save up for a year.
answers: Mary a year to save up for a new car.
Mary a year to save up enough for a new car.
a year for Mary to save up for a new car.
questions.explanation: had to + V + for + thời gian → It took + sb + thời gian + to V.

sections.title: Practice 16: It is… since + clause
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: I haven't seen her for three weeks. → It's three weeks since I (last) saw her.

questions.original: John hasn't had his car repaired for over six months.
answers: over six months since John last had his car repaired.
over six months since John had his car repaired.
more than six months since John last had his car repaired.
more than six months since John had his car repaired.
questions.explanation: S + hasn’t + V3 + for + thời gian → It is + thời gian + since + S + (last) + V2. “hasn’t had” → “last had”.

questions.original: I haven't had a holiday for two years.
answers: two years since I last had a holiday.
two years since I had a holiday.
questions.explanation: S + haven’t + V3 + for + thời gian → It is + thời gian + since + S + (last) + V2.

questions.original: They haven't visited us for ages.
answers: ages since they last visited us.
ages since they visited us.
questions.explanation: S + haven’t + V3 + for + thời gian → It is + thời gian + since + S + (last) + V2.

questions.original: We have known each other for 6 months.
answers: 6 months since we first met.
six months since we first met.
6 months since we met.
six months since we met.
6 months since we got to know each other.
six months since we got to know each other.
questions.explanation: have known… for + thời gian → It is + thời gian + since + S + first met. Điểm bắt đầu quen nhau là lúc “first met”.

questions.original: Nam hasn't been to Nha Trang for 2 years.
answers: 2 years since Nam last went to Nha Trang.
two years since Nam last went to Nha Trang.
2 years since Nam last visited Nha Trang.
two years since Nam last visited Nha Trang.
2 years since Nam last was in Nha Trang.
two years since Nam last was in Nha Trang.
2 years since Nam went to Nha Trang.
two years since Nam went to Nha Trang.
questions.explanation: S + hasn’t + V3 + for + thời gian → It is + thời gian + since + S + last + V2. “hasn’t been to” → “last went to / visited”.

sections.title: Practice 17: The more… the more…
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: As it is hotter, I feel more miserable. → The hotter it is, the more miserable I feel.

questions.original: You leave sooner. You will arrive at your destination earlier.
answers: you leave, the earlier you will arrive at your destination.
you leave, the earlier you'll arrive at your destination.
you leave the earlier you will arrive at your destination.
questions.explanation: So sánh kép: The + so sánh hơn + S + V, the + so sánh hơn + S + V. Hai câu được nối thành một.

questions.original: As T.V programmes become more popular, they seem to get worse.
answers: popular T.V programmes become, the worse they seem to get.
popular TV programmes become, the worse they seem to get.
popular T.V programmes become the worse they seem to get.
popular TV programmes become, the worse they seem.
questions.explanation: As + so sánh hơn → The + so sánh hơn + S + V, the + so sánh hơn + S + V. “more popular” đi liền sau “the more”.

questions.original: If we sit near to the stage, we can see clearly.
answers: the stage we sit, the more clearly we can see.
the stage we sit, the clearer we can see.
the stage we sit the more clearly we can see.
questions.explanation: If + điều kiện → The + so sánh hơn…, the + so sánh hơn…. “near” → “the nearer”, “clearly” → “the more clearly”.

questions.original: That worker works better when he does not have enough time.
answers: time that worker has, the better he works.
time that worker has, the better he'll work.
time that worker has the better he works.
questions.explanation: Không đủ thời gian ≈ ít thời gian hơn → The less + danh từ + S + V, the + so sánh hơn + S + V.

questions.original: As he grows older, he becomes increasingly cheerful.
answers: he grows, the more cheerful he becomes.
he gets, the more cheerful he becomes.
he grows the more cheerful he becomes.
he grows, the more cheerful he gets.
questions.explanation: As + so sánh hơn → The + so sánh hơn + S + V, the + so sánh hơn + S + V. “increasingly cheerful” → “the more cheerful”.

sections.title: Practice 18: Suggest + noun clause
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.
examples: Why don't you buy them the picture as a wedding present, Sarah? → Robin suggested that Sarah (should) buy the picture as a wedding present.

questions.original: “Why don't you apply for the job, Ann?” said Sue.
answers: that Ann should apply for the job.
that Ann apply for the job.
Ann should apply for the job.
Ann apply for the job.
questions.explanation: Suggest + that + S + (should) + V nguyên mẫu: câu hỏi “Why don’t you…?” là lời gợi ý, chuyển thành “suggested (that) + chủ ngữ + (should) + V”. “you” đổi theo người được gợi ý.

questions.original: “Why don't you put an advertisement in the local paper?” they said to me.
answers: that I should put an advertisement in the local paper.
that I put an advertisement in the local paper.
I should put an advertisement in the local paper.
I put an advertisement in the local paper.
questions.explanation: Suggest + that + S + (should) + V nguyên mẫu: câu hỏi “Why don’t you…?” là lời gợi ý, chuyển thành “suggested (that) + chủ ngữ + (should) + V”. “you” đổi theo người được gợi ý.

questions.original: “Why don't you go to Paris to study French?” Mary asked Peter.
answers: that Peter should go to Paris to study French.
that Peter go to Paris to study French.
Peter should go to Paris to study French.
Peter go to Paris to study French.
questions.explanation: Suggest + that + S + (should) + V nguyên mẫu: câu hỏi “Why don’t you…?” là lời gợi ý, chuyển thành “suggested (that) + chủ ngữ + (should) + V”. “you” đổi theo người được gợi ý.

questions.original: The doctor said, “Why don't you stop smoking?”
answers: that I should stop smoking.
that I stop smoking.
that he should stop smoking.
that he stop smoking.
that she should stop smoking.
that she stop smoking.
that they should stop smoking.
that they stop smoking.
I should stop smoking.
I stop smoking.
questions.explanation: Suggest + that + S + (should) + V nguyên mẫu: câu hỏi “Why don’t you…?” là lời gợi ý, chuyển thành “suggested (that) + chủ ngữ + (should) + V”. “you” đổi theo người được gợi ý. Người nghe không được nêu rõ nên chấp nhận I / he / she / they.

questions.original: The teacher said, “Why don't you take the prerequisites before registering for this course?”
answers: that we should take the prerequisites before registering for this course.
that we take the prerequisites before registering for this course.
that I should take the prerequisites before registering for this course.
that I take the prerequisites before registering for this course.
that he should take the prerequisites before registering for this course.
that he take the prerequisites before registering for this course.
that she should take the prerequisites before registering for this course.
that she take the prerequisites before registering for this course.
that they should take the prerequisites before registering for this course.
that they take the prerequisites before registering for this course.
we should take the prerequisites before registering for this course.
we take the prerequisites before registering for this course.
questions.explanation: Suggest + that + S + (should) + V nguyên mẫu: câu hỏi “Why don’t you…?” là lời gợi ý, chuyển thành “suggested (that) + chủ ngữ + (should) + V”. “you” đổi theo người được gợi ý. Người nghe không được nêu rõ nên chấp nhận we / I / he / she / they.

sections.title: Practice 19: Let’s + V — Why don’t we…?
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.

questions.original: Let's try that new pizza place.
answers: we try that new pizza place?
questions.explanation: Let’s + V → Why don’t we + V…? Cả hai đều là lời rủ rê, đề nghị cùng làm; kết thúc bằng dấu hỏi.

questions.original: Let's share the cost of accommodation.
answers: we share the cost of accommodation?
questions.explanation: Let’s + V → Why don’t we + V…? Cả hai đều là lời rủ rê, đề nghị cùng làm; kết thúc bằng dấu hỏi.

questions.original: Let's get together next Sunday.
answers: we get together next Sunday?
questions.explanation: Let’s + V → Why don’t we + V…? Cả hai đều là lời rủ rê, đề nghị cùng làm; kết thúc bằng dấu hỏi.

questions.original: Let's plan to meet when we both have free time.
answers: we plan to meet when we both have free time?
questions.explanation: Let’s + V → Why don’t we + V…? Cả hai đều là lời rủ rê, đề nghị cùng làm; kết thúc bằng dấu hỏi.

questions.original: Let's stay in this evening.
answers: we stay in this evening?
we stay in tonight?
questions.explanation: Let’s + V → Why don’t we + V…? Cả hai đều là lời rủ rê, đề nghị cùng làm; kết thúc bằng dấu hỏi.

sections.title: Practice 20A: Direct speech — Indirect speech (Yes/No questions)
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.

questions.original: She said, “Are you hungry, Tom?”
answers: Tom if he was hungry.
Tom whether he was hungry.
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Yes/No trực tiếp → ask/wonder + if/whether + mệnh đề khẳng định (không đảo ngữ, lùi thì, đổi đại từ). “Are you hungry” → “if he was hungry”.

questions.original: Tom said, “Can you remember where you put the dictionary, Mary?”
answers: Mary if she could remember where she had put the dictionary.
Mary whether she could remember where she had put the dictionary.
Mary if she could remember where she put the dictionary.
Mary whether she could remember where she put the dictionary.
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Yes/No trực tiếp → ask/wonder + if/whether + mệnh đề khẳng định (không đảo ngữ, lùi thì, đổi đại từ). “can” → “could”, “you put” → “she had put”.

questions.original: My brother said to her, “Did you see George at the football match?”
answers: her if she had seen George at the football match.
her whether she had seen George at the football match.
her if she saw George at the football match.
her whether she saw George at the football match.
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Yes/No trực tiếp → ask/wonder + if/whether + mệnh đề khẳng định (không đảo ngữ, lùi thì, đổi đại từ). “did you see” → “she had seen” (lùi thì quá khứ đơn → quá khứ hoàn thành).

questions.original: She said, “Didn't they all do the exercise correctly?”
answers: whether they hadn't all done the exercise correctly.
if they hadn't all done the exercise correctly.
whether they had not all done the exercise correctly.
if they had not all done the exercise correctly.
whether they had all done the exercise correctly.
if they had all done the exercise correctly.
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Yes/No phủ định → wonder + if/whether + mệnh đề; “didn’t they all do” → “they hadn’t all done” (lùi thì, bỏ đảo ngữ).

questions.original: She said to me, “Will you go with me?”
answers: me if I would go with her.
me whether I would go with her.
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Yes/No trực tiếp → ask/wonder + if/whether + mệnh đề khẳng định (không đảo ngữ, lùi thì, đổi đại từ). “will” → “would”, “you” → “I”, “me” → “her”.

sections.title: Practice 20B: Direct speech — Indirect speech (Wh- questions)
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.

questions.original: “Where did you buy your shoes, Sally?” asked Gail.
answers: Sally where she had bought her shoes.
Sally where she bought her shoes.
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Wh- trực tiếp → asked + từ để hỏi + mệnh đề khẳng định (không đảo ngữ, lùi thì, đổi đại từ). “did you buy” → “she had bought”.

questions.original: “Why don't you close the door, John?” said Mrs. Clark.
answers: John why he didn't close the door.
John why he did not close the door.
John why he hadn't closed the door.
John why he had not closed the door.
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Wh- trực tiếp → asked + từ để hỏi + mệnh đề khẳng định (không đảo ngữ, lùi thì, đổi đại từ). “don’t you close” → “he didn’t close”.

questions.original: Tom asked me “What is her name?”
answers: me what her name was.
me what her name is.
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Wh- trực tiếp → asked + từ để hỏi + mệnh đề khẳng định (không đảo ngữ, lùi thì, đổi đại từ). “is” → “was”, trật tự chủ ngữ + động từ: “her name was”.

questions.original: He said, “Why do they go to Paris so often?”
answers: why they went to Paris so often.
why they go to Paris so often.
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Wh- trực tiếp → asked + từ để hỏi + mệnh đề khẳng định (không đảo ngữ, lùi thì, đổi đại từ). “do they go” → “they went”.

questions.original: I said to my brother, “How much did you pay for these overripe tomatoes?”
answers: my brother how much he had paid for those overripe tomatoes.
my brother how much he paid for those overripe tomatoes.
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Wh- trực tiếp → asked + từ để hỏi + mệnh đề khẳng định (không đảo ngữ, lùi thì, đổi đại từ). “you” → “he”, “these” → “those”, “did pay” → “had paid”.

sections.title: Practice 20C: Direct speech — Indirect speech (commands & requests)
sections.instruction: Viết lại câu sao cho nghĩa không đổi, bắt đầu bằng phần cho sẵn.

questions.original: He said to the stewardess, “Please bring me some hot drink.”
answers: the stewardess to bring him some hot drink.
the stewardess to bring him a hot drink.
questions.explanation: Lời yêu cầu lịch sự (có “please”) → requested + sb + to V. “me” → “him”, bỏ “please”.

questions.original: “Don't swim too far out”, she warned him.
answers: him not to swim too far out.
questions.explanation: Lời cảnh báo phủ định → warned + sb + not to V. “Don’t swim” → “not to swim”.

questions.original: The officer gave the order: “Fire!”
answers: them to fire.
his men to fire.
the soldiers to fire.
the men to fire.
them to open fire.
his men to open fire.
the soldiers to open fire.
questions.explanation: Mệnh lệnh → ordered + sb + to V. “Fire!” → “to fire”; người nhận lệnh không nêu rõ nên chấp nhận them / his men / the soldiers.

questions.original: The teacher said to his student, “Don't be late tomorrow.”
answers: his student not to be late the next day.
his student not to be late the following day.
his student not to be late tomorrow.
the student not to be late the next day.
the student not to be late the following day.
questions.explanation: Lời dặn phủ định → told + sb + not to V. “tomorrow” → “the next day / the following day”.

questions.original: The officer said to the soldier, “Present arms!”
answers: the soldier to present arms.
the soldier to present his arms.
questions.explanation: Mệnh lệnh → ordered + sb + to V. “Present arms!” → “to present arms”.
